self_conditional_modifiers_json.description: Black Wing (R1): Normal and Charged Attack hits have a 50% chance to trigger a vacuum blade dealing 40% of ATK as AoE DMG (once every 2s max). Modeled as a supplementary hit of 40% ATK — its own rotation target (weapon/normalExtraHit + weapon/chargedExtraHit), weight = how many blades land (the 2s ICD is treated as reliably triggered during sustained combat); physical, scales with ATK and CRIT only, no DMG% bonuses. Normal ATK SPD +12% not modeled (non-combat).
